skills.name: folkso
skills.description: Find real people for a task with Folkso and manage the user's own Folkso profile. Use when the user wants to find, hire, meet or team up with a person (a developer, designer, lawyer, consultant, co-founder, mentor, investor, volunteers, people to teach or to meet in their city), asks whether someone replied to their Folkso request, or wants to create, update or pause their own Folkso profile to appear in AI answers.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Folkso 寻找开发者、设计师、律师、顾问、联合创始人、导师、投资人或志愿者等真实人员来合作、聘用、学习或见面，查看请求回复，并创建、更新或暂停用户自己的 Folkso 档案以出现在 AI 回答中。
